llm_explanation: To determine the rating, I first considered if the utterance could be neutral, as it states a procedural rule in a formal tone. However, I questioned the phrasing "Pues ya habrá alguien que desee indagar y probar adecuadamente," which translates to "Well, there will be someone who wishes to properly investigate and prove."
